25.example: The whole family was involved in playing the game.

25.definition: Medicine is something you take to feel better or treat an illness.
25.example: The doctor gave me medicine for my cold.

25.definition: A mix is different things put together.
25.example: The green mix we made in science class spilled onto the table.

25.definition: To organize is to plan or get ready for an event.
25.example: Make a list to help you organize the things you need.

25.definition: A period is an amount of time when something happens.
25.example: In one period in Europe, there were many knights.

25.definition: If people populate an area, they live there.
25.example: Billions of people populate the Earth.

25.definition: To produce something is to make or grow it.
25.example: This tree produces apples every year.

25.definition: A range is a number or a set of similar things.
25.example: I saw a range of cars to choose from.

25.definition: To recognize something is to know it because you have seen it before.
25.example: I recognized an old friend from many years ago.

25.definition: If something is regular, it happens often and in equal amounts of time.
25.example: Our regular lunch time is around noon.

25.definition: A sign is an indication giving information, directions, a warning, etc.
25.example: The sign indicated that today would be a bad day.

25.definition: A tip is a pointed end of something.
25.example: The tip of his pen was very sharp.

25.definition: A tradition is something people have been doing for a long time.
25.example: Marriage is a tradition all over the world.

25.definition: Trash is waste material or unwanted or worthless things.
25.example: Please take out the trash; it smells bad.

25.definition: If something is wide, it is large from side to side.
25.example: The door was as wide as my arms.

26.definition: Advice is an opinion about what to do.
26.example: I don't know how to study for my exams. Can you give me some advice?

26.definition: Along means down the length of a road, river, etc.
26.example: Walk along this tunnel for ten minutes, and you'll see a door on the left.

26.definition: Attention is the notice, thought, or consideration of someone.
26.example: His work got the attention of two of his co-workers.

26.definition: To attract means to make a person or thing come closer or be interested.
26.example: The magnet attracted the metal.

26.definition: To climb means to use your hands and feet to go up something.
26.example: The girls climbed to the top of the mountain.

26.definition: To drop is to fall or allow something to fall.
26.example: A small amount of water dropped from the bottle.

26.definition: If something is final, it is the last part.
26.example: In the final part of the film, the man and the woman got married.

26.definition: Further means at or from a greater distance or time.
26.example: The escalator is further than I thought.

26.definition: To imply something is to suggest it without saying it.
26.example: The man implied that he wanted the job, but he didn't say so.

26.definition: To maintain means to make something stay the same.
26.example: The balls maintain constant movement.

26.definition: You use neither to connect two negative possibilities.
26.example: Neither the path on the left nor the path on the right will lead us home.
26.arabic: لا هذا ولا ذاك / أيٌّ منهما لا

26.definition: Otherwise means in another way if you don't do this.
26.example: It's good to stay active; otherwise, you'll gain weight.

26.definition: If something is physical, it is related to your body and not your mind.
26.example: Biking is good for your physical health.

26.definition: To prove something is to show that it is true.
26.example: My teacher proved the answer on the board.

26.definition: To react is to respond by acting in a certain way.
26.example: James reacted badly to the news.

26.definition: To ride something is to travel on it. You can ride an animal, a bike, etc.
26.example: I will ride a roller coaster for the first time today.

26.definition: If something is situated somewhere, it is in that place.
26.example: The whiteboard is situated between the two men.

26.definition: Society is a group of people who interact and share a culture.
26.example: Society expects people to be good and honest.

26.definition: A standard is what people consider normal or good.
26.example: This older model TV is below our store's standards.

26.definition: To suggest something is to give an idea or plan about it.
26.example: He suggested that we go to see his boss.

27.definition: Actually means in fact or really.
27.example: My dad looks a little mean, but actually he's very kind.

27.definition: Bite is the act of using your teeth to cut and tear into something.
27.example: The boy took a big bite of his hamburger.

27.definition: The coast is the land by an ocean.
27.example: I stayed on the southern coast of Australia.

27.definition: A deal is an agreement that you have with another person.
27.example: I made a deal with the other company to give us some money.

27.definition: The desert is an area of land without many plants or water.
27.example: Not many plants grow in the desert.

27.definition: If something is effective, it works well.
27.example: Swimming is an effective way to stay healthy.

27.definition: To examine something is to look at it carefully.
27.example: The doctor examined my eyes today.

27.definition: If something is false, it is not correct.
27.example: If you think the answer is false, press the red button.

27.definition: When you figure something out, you come to understand it and find an answer.
27.example: I couldn't figure out what he wanted me to do.

27.definition: A gift is something you give someone.
27.example: Dave received many gifts for Christmas.

27.definition: Hunger is the feeling that you get when you need to eat.
27.example: After playing all day long, he was filled with hunger.

27.definition: To imagine something is to think of it in your mind.
27.example: Sally imagined herself winning lots of money.

27.definition: A journey is a long trip.
27.example: I went on a journey across the country with my parents.

27.definition: A puzzle is something that is hard to understand.
27.example: The question was a puzzle to him.

27.definition: Quite means that something is a certain way completely or very much.
27.example: I think typing on a keyboard is quite easy.

27.definition: Rather is used when you want to do one thing but not the other.
27.example: I would rather have the red one than the blue one.

27.definition: If something is specific, it is precise or exact.
27.example: Please choose a specific place on the map.

27.definition: A spider is a small creature with eight legs.
27.example: Some adults have a fear of little creatures such as spiders.

27.definition: A tour is a short trip in which you see many sights.
27.example: I took a tour of Asia and Europe.

27.definition: A trip is a journey to a certain place.
27.example: Ken took a trip to the city yesterday.

28.definition: A band is a group of people who play music.
28.example: My brother is in a rock band.

28.definition: Barely means by the smallest amount, almost not.
28.example: I barely had enough money to pay for my bus ticket.

28.definition: If something is boring, it is not fun.
28.example: I think the internet is boring.

28.definition: To cancel means to decide that an event or a request will not happen.
28.example: She canceled the rest of her plans because of the rain.

28.definition: A driveway is a short private road that leads to a person's home.
28.example: The long driveway led us to their new house.

28.definition: Garbage is waste material like unwanted or spoiled food, bottles, paper, etc.
28.example: The boy cleaned up the garbage around his house.

28.definition: An instrument is something designed to do a certain task like play music.
28.example: My favorite musical instrument is the piano.

28.definition: A list is a record of information printed with an item on each line.
28.example: My mom makes a list of groceries to buy.

28.definition: Magic is the power to do impossible things.
28.example: The magician used magic to pull a rabbit out of his hat.

28.definition: A message is a set of words that you send to someone.
28.example: I left a message for you in the envelope.

28.definition: To notice something is to see it for the first time.
28.example: Did you notice the view?

28.definition: To own something means to have it. That thing belongs to you.
28.example: My grandfather owns that house.

28.definition: To predict something is to say that it will happen.
28.example: She predicted that I would get married next year.

28.definition: A professor is a person who teaches in college.
28.example: Mike's science professor knows a lot about physics.

28.definition: To rush is to go somewhere or do something very quickly.
28.example: Nancy rushed to finish her homework.

28.definition: A schedule is a plan that tells you when to do things.
28.example: What is your class schedule for today?

28.definition: To share something is to give some of it to another person.
28.example: Jimmy shared his apple with me.

28.definition: A stage is a place where actors or musicians act or sing.
28.example: A large screen was on the stage.

28.definition: A storm is very bad weather. There is a lot of rain or snow.
28.example: Did that storm wake you up last night?

28.definition: If you are within something, you are inside another thing.
28.example: Within the box, there was a pizza.

29.definition: A burden is a serious or difficult responsibility.
29.example: Children who do not behave are a burden to their parents.

29.definition: To compromise is to agree to something that is not exactly what you want.
29.example: We both compromised about the game we decided to play.

29.definition: To craft something is to make it using skill.
29.example: She crafted the bookcase out of solid pine wood and then painted it.

29.definition: When you dive into water, you go down head first into the water.
29.example: I like sky-diving from an airplane.

29.definition: When people or things are fragile, they are not strong and can be damaged easily.
29.example: The fragile glassware was carefully packed into boxes.

29.definition: If you cut something into two parts that are the same size, you cut it in half.
29.example: The machine can divide the book in half.

29.definition: Innocence is a lack of experience of difficult or complex things in life.
29.example: Everyone who met her found her innocence to be charming.

29.definition: When you lead something, you go first and it follows you.
29.example: I will lead you to the right place.

29.definition: When you have a meeting, you are with other people.
29.example: We have lots of meetings at our school to plan what to do.

29.definition: To merge two things is to combine them into one whole thing.
29.example: The storm clouds merged into one large menacing cloud that filled the sky.

29.definition: When something is moderate, it is not too big or too small or even or average.
29.example: It takes a moderate amount of patience to be around small children all day.

29.definition: To overwhelm is to exist in such a large amount that someone cannot deal with it.
29.example: The amount of homework her teacher assigned has overwhelmed her.

29.definition: When you make a payment, you give someone some money for what you get.
29.example: I made the last payment on my car yesterday. Now I am really the owner.

29.definition: A perception of a situation is a way of thinking about it or understanding it.
29.example: Since he couldn't see, his perception of life was much different than mine.

29.definition: When you settle something, you reach an agreement.
29.example: We settled the argument by looking up the answer on the web.

29.definition: A shiver is a shaking movement the body makes when someone is cold or scared.
29.example: I got shivers on my way home because it was so cold.

29.definition: When someone is sociable, they are friendly.
29.example: Many of my good friends are sociable, but I am shy.

29.definition: When you speed, you go very fast.
29.example: Speeding is the cause of most car accidents.

29.definition: When someone is talkative, he or she talks a lot.
29.example: My aunt is very talkative whenever she is on the phone.

29.definition: When something is usual, it is what we expect.
29.example: It was just the usual people who came.

30.definition: If something is above, it is at a higher level than something else.
30.example: He straightened the sign that was above the crowd.

30.definition: If something is ahead of something else, it is in front of it.
30.example: The blue car drove on ahead of us.

30.definition: An amount is how much there is of something.
30.example: Can I use my card to pay for the entire amount?

30.definition: A belief is a strong feeling that something is correct or true.
30.example: A preacher or priest should have a strong belief in God.

30.definition: The center of something is the middle of it.
30.example: The center of a dart board is the most important spot.

30.definition: If something is common, it happens often or there is much of it.
30.example: It is common for snow to fall in the winter.

30.definition: To cost is to require payment.
30.example: These designer shoes cost more than the regular ones.

30.definition: To demonstrate something is to show how it is done.
30.example: She demonstrated her plan to her co-workers.

30.definition: Different describes someone or something that is not the same as others.
30.example: Each of my sisters has a different hair style.

30.definition: Evidence is a fact or thing that you use to prove something.
30.example: He used the pictures as evidence that UFOs are real.

30.definition: Honesty means the quality of being truthful or honest.
30.example: A courtroom should be a place of honesty.

30.definition: An idiom is a phrase with a meaning different from its words.
30.example: The idiom "when pigs fly" means that something will never happen.

30.definition: If something is independent, it is not controlled by something else.
30.example: She chose to live an independent life in the country.

30.definition: Inside means the inner part, space or side of something.
30.example: The inside of the box was empty.

30.definition: A jail is a place to keep bad people.
30.example: He was sent to jail for taking other people's cars.

30.definition: A master is a person who is very good at something.
30.example: My brother is a master of taekwondo.

30.definition: A memory is something you remember.
30.example: The memory of my first time in the city will always be the best.

30.definition: A pocket is a part of your clothing where you can keep things.
30.example: She always had her hands in her pockets.

30.definition: If something is proper, it is right.
30.example: It is not proper to throw your garbage on the road.

30.definition: A sale is when something is for sale, you can buy it.
30.example: Everything for sale here is the same price.
